findings.title: Super-admin credentials from user request not reflected in design
findings.summary: User explicitly requested username 'Adminmungai' and password 'Mbatia2000'. Design defaults to 'admin@campusconnect.app' / 'ChangeMe123!' with no path to seed the requested credentials.

findings.title: manifest.json and sw.js served at wrong paths for PWA compliance
findings.location: Project structure, static/ folder, AC-23, AC-24
findings.summary: Design places manifest.json at /static/manifest.json and sw.js at /static/sw.js. AC-23 requires /manifest.json; AC-24 requires /sw.js. Service worker at /static/sw.js only controls /static/ scope, not the whole app.

findings.title: seed.py body is incompletely specified — app context wrapper missing
findings.summary: Design shows seed_super_admin() function but not the surrounding script that creates the app context. Without app.app_context(), running seed.py standalone raises RuntimeError. db.create_all() placement with 2 Gunicorn workers also creates a SQLite lock race.

findings.title: super_admin isolation on institution-scoped endpoints is undocumented in endpoint specs
findings.summary: The 403-for-super_admin rule is buried in Edge Case 5 and never appears as explicit logic in any blueprint endpoint. Implementers may miss it. Needs a documented before_request guard pattern.

findings.title: AC-20 requires HTTP 403 on deactivated-institution login but design returns 401
findings.summary: Design returns 401 'Institution inactive.' but AC-20 says HTTP 403. The design and acceptance criteria conflict.

findings.title: roles_required decorator usage ambiguity — documentation missing
findings.summary: roles_required already wraps jwt_required() internally but this is not documented. Developers may double-decorate or misuse get_jwt() outside the decorator context. Needs a docstring and usage note.

findings.title: Library DELETE deletes DB record before disk file — crash leaves orphan files
findings.summary: DB commit happens before os.remove(). A crash between the two leaves a file on disk with no DB record. Reversing the order (disk first, then DB) is safer because a dangling DB record is handled gracefully by the download endpoint.

findings.title: GET /api/dashboard does not specify behaviour for lecturer/admin callers
findings.summary: The 'completed' annotation is specified for student callers only. The design is silent on what lecturers and institution_admins receive for the assignments section of the dashboard response.

findings.title: SQLite with 2 Gunicorn workers needs WAL mode and busy_timeout — not specified
findings.summary: Without WAL mode and a busy_timeout pragma, concurrent write requests across 2 workers will produce 'database is locked' 500 errors. This needs to be specified in config.py.

findings.title: No endpoint to create the first institution_admin for a new institution
findings.summary: POST /api/admin/my/users is an institution_admin route (uses caller's institution_id). Super admin routes have no POST /api/admin/users to create users for other institutions. First institution_admin for each institution cannot be provisioned.

findings.title: GET /api/library missing ORDER BY clause
findings.summary: No ordering is defined for library file listings. Pagination over an unordered result set is non-deterministic.

findings.title: GET /api/marketplace/items missing default sort order
findings.summary: Query params are defined but no ORDER BY is specified. Pagination is non-deterministic without a stable ordering.

findings.title: price field in marketplace POST has no upper bound, type coercion rule, or infinity guard
findings.summary: Design says 'numeric >= 0' but does not reject strings, NaN, infinity, or values over a reasonable maximum. float('inf') would pass validation.

findings.title: Community comment nesting validation missing error code and cascade delete spec
findings.location: app/community.py POST comment handler, app/models.py CommunityComment
findings.summary: Design validates one-level nesting but does not specify the HTTP 400 message, nor does it define cascade='all, delete-orphan' on the self-referential CommunityComment relationship for reply cleanup.

findings.title: Lost & Found date_occurred future-date validation has no specified HTTP response or lower bound
findings.summary: Design says 'not in the future' but does not specify the 400 response message or a reasonable lower bound. No code path documented for the error case.

findings.title: User.query.get_or_404() is deprecated in Flask-SQLAlchemy 3.x
findings.summary: Use db.session.get(User, user_id) or abort(404) instead.

findings.title: datetime.utcnow() is deprecated in Python 3.12+
findings.summary: Replace default=datetime.utcnow with default=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc) to avoid future breakage.

findings.title: requirements.txt has no lock file or transitive dependency pins
findings.summary: Only direct dependencies are pinned. Consider pip-tools or a requirements.lock for reproducible builds.

findings.title: sw.js SHELL_ASSETS list uses a placeholder comment instead of enumerating all JS modules
findings.summary: /* all other JS modules */ is not implementable. All paths must be explicitly listed.

findings.title: Dockerfile CMD missing --timeout 120 that is mentioned in prose
findings.summary: Design prose says '--timeout 120 is added to handle large file uploads' but the Dockerfile CMD snippet does not include it. Only render.yaml's startCommand has it.

findings.title: today_classes uses strftime('%a') which is locale-dependent
findings.summary: On non-English locale servers, strftime('%a') returns a non-English day abbreviation that will never match the stored 'Mon'/'Tue'/etc. values. Use calendar.day_abbr[datetime.utcnow().weekday()] instead.

findings.title: FR-2.4 quick-link navigation buttons not addressed in dashboard.js frontend spec
findings.summary: FR-2.4 requires quick-link buttons on the dashboard. The dashboard.js module spec only describes consuming API data. The quick-link UI is never mentioned.
